query:
SELECT
                c.comment_id,
                c.post_id,
                c.user_id,
                u.username,
                u.full_name,
                c.content,
                c.created_at,
                c.bot_score,
                CAST(COUNT(l.user_id) AS UNSIGNED) AS likes_count,
                MAX(l2.user_id IS NOT NULL) AS is_liked
            FROM
                comments AS c
            INNER JOIN
                users AS u ON c.user_id = u.user_id
            LEFT JOIN
                likes AS l ON c.comment_id = l.comment_id AND l.comment_id IS NOT NULL
            LEFT JOIN
                likes AS l2 ON c.comment_id = l2.comment_id AND l2.user_id = ? AND l2.comment_id IS NOT NULL
            WHERE
                c.post_id = ?
            GROUP BY
                c.comment_id,
                c.post_id,
                c.user_id,
                u.username,
                u.full_name,
                c.content,
                c.created_at,
                c.bot_score
            ORDER BY
                created_at DESC
            LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
